channel.title: CEE Legal Matters - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CEE Legal Matters (ceelegalmatters.com)

item.title: Serbian Competition Commission Submits Four Draft Proposals to Government for Block Exemption Regulations
item.description: On 21 January 2025, the Serbian Commission for Protection of Competition submitted draft proposals to the Government for four new regulations concerning the exemption of certain categories of agreements from the prohibition of restrictive agreements.

item.title: Rymarz Zdort Maruta and SK&S Advise on PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna's Baltica 2 Offshore Wind Farm Finalization
item.description: Rymarz Zdort Maruta has advised PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna on the implementation of the Baltica 2 investment project involving the construction of an offshore wind farm in a joint venture with Orsted Group. Hengeler Mueller and SK&S advised Orsted.

item.title: Walless Advises ICA Gruppen on Sale of Rimi Baltic Group to Salling Group
item.description: Walless, working with Gernandt & Danielsson, has advised ICA Gruppen on the sale of Rimi Baltic Group to Salling Group for EUR 1.3 billion. Sorainen reportedly advised Salling Group on the deal.

item.title: Closing: ICA Gruppen's Sale of Rimi Baltic Group to Salling Group Now Closed
item.description: On June 3, 2025, Sorainen announced that ICA Gruppen's sale of Rimi Baltic Group to Salling Group (as reported by CEE Legal Matters on March 12, 2025) has now closed.

item.title: Dorda and Brandl Talos Advise on DRS Investment's Acquisition of Aurena
item.description: Dorda, working with Heuking and Goerg, has advised German investor DRS Investment on its acquisition of a majority stake in Aurena. Brandl Talos, working with Ego Humrich Wyen, advised Aurena founder Karl Kuehberger.

item.title: Ilej & Partners in Cooperation With Karanovic & Partners, Havel & Partners, and Wolf Theiss Advise on MTX Group's Acquisition of Omial Novi from Aluflexpack Group
item.description: Ilej & Partners in cooperation with Karanovic & Partners and Havel & Partners have advised Czech industrial group MTX Group on its acquisition of Croatian company Omial Novi from Swiss-based Aluflexpack Group. Wolf Theiss, working with Willkie Farr & Gallagher, advised Aluflexpack.

item.title: Three Make Partner at Stankovic & Partners
item.description: Stankovic & Partners has promoted Sara Pendjer, Mitar Simonovic, and Ivan Nikolic to Junior Partner.

item.title: Closing: Sale of Regina Maria Group to Mehilainen Now Closed
item.description: In December 2025, Karanovic & Partners announced that the sale of Regina Maria Group to Mehilainen (as reported by CEE Legal Matters on April 11, 2025) has now closed.

item.title: Sorainen Successful for Kullike Namm Before Estonia's Supreme Court in Criminal Case
item.description: Sorainen has successfully represented Attorney at Law Kullike Namm in a criminal case before the Supreme Court of Estonia, resulting in a full acquittal of all charges.

item.title: CMS Advises CCE on Sale of Horia 2 Solar Project to Renalfa Solarpro Group
item.description: CMS has advised CCE on the sale of Horia Solar Invest Two, the special purpose vehicle developing the Horia 2 solar project in Arad County, Romania, to Renalfa Solarpro Group.
